pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Speaking Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
In the IELTS speaking test you must have an 11-14 minute discussion with an examiner.

The test is given in 3 parts:

Part 1: yourself and your family

Part 2 & 3: random topic

In the lesson we will practice for part 1, 2, and 3. I will time you and give you corrections on your grammar, pronunciation, and vocabulary. I will help you give longer answers and express yourself with more fluency.

The scores are given from band 0 to band 9. Since I am not an examiner and don't work for the IELTS exams I can't give you a score for you to know your level but I can help you do your best at the level that you are at.

pro_course_detail.description:
The TOEFL speaking section measures your ability to communicate in an academic setting, the 4 questions will resemble real life situations you may encounter inside and outside of school.
